body.notes: CONTRAST: OPERATOR-REPORTED MISS, 2026-09-08. Operator screenshotted a black box with black text directly above the H1 on /full-size-track-loaders/, a page I had declared contrast-clean hours earlier. My check had measured ONLY green links, so every other colour pair was invisible to it. Full sweep of every text node across all 53 published pages: 1,332 failing elements, every page affected, but only 30 distinct colour pairs. Tool saved at D:/cc-assistant/tools/contrast-sweep.mjs. ROOT CAUSE of the reported bug: 29 kicker pills (elType heading, tag div, uppercase) have title_color and _background_color set to the SAME hex, 27 at #141414 on #141414 and 2 at #01B51B on #01B51B, so they render as solid blobs. QUEUED 1207-1235 (29 cards, two batches, zero warnings) setting title_color only; walk_and_update does array_merge so a single-key payload is safe. Fix values taken from the site's OWN working siblings, not invented: #FFFFFF on #141414 pills ('Telescopic', 'Flagship'), #141414 on #01B51B pills ('Financing Made Easy', 'Most Powerful In Class'). Affected pages 18, 37, 39, 41, 43, 45, 47. FALSE POSITIVE I CAUGHT BEFORE REPORTING: the first sweep claimed info@mammothmachinery.ca and the Burlington street address were white-on-white in the footer of all 53 pages. Screenshotted it: the footer sits on a dark background IMAGE and reads perfectly. My backdrop walk defaulted to white when no opaque background-color existed. Fixed the sweep to treat any intervening background-image as INDETERMINATE. Do not re-raise the footer as broken. STILL OPEN, NOT queued, needs a design decision because it is the site's dominant pattern not a bug: 238 instances of #FFFFFF text on #01B51B green at 2.75:1 (button labels, green pills) plus 378 instances of #01B51B text on white at 2.75:1. The design skill already rules on this: pair green fills with #141414 text, never small green text on white. Fixing it properly is a brand-level pass across buttons and pills sitewide, so propose before touching. Also open: 7 non-pill invisible items (3 red-on-grey required asterisks and a 0/180 char counter on /financing/ widget 29883987, 'Service Center'/'Service Partner' white-on-white map legends on /find-a-dealer/ widgets b022ac2 and 71d3b1f, and 'Find your nearest dealer' black on #0f0f0f on /mini-skidsteers/ widget 2a47413f). Also: #787878 (kit 'text' token) on white is 4.42:1 across 218 instances, a real AA fail the design skill already flags as borderline.
